title: Mission: The Printer
subtitle: Build the printer and see how it prints a page.
summary: Meet the printer, learn its parts, and send a picture to the paper.
activityInstruction: Load the paper, start the printer, and watch it work.

storyQuestions.success: A printer puts ink on paper.

storyQuestions.prompt: Where does the paper go in?
storyQuestions.success: The paper goes into the tray.
The rollers pull the paper through.

storyQuestions.prompt: What makes the colors on the page?
storyQuestions.success: The ink cartridges make the colors.

quiz.success: The paper tray holds the paper.

quiz.prompt: What moves the paper through the printer?

quiz.success: The ink cartridges hold the colors.

quiz.prompt: Where does the printed page come out?
quiz.success: The printed page comes out of the output tray.

parts.label: Paper Tray
parts.fact: The paper tray holds the blank paper before it is printed.
parts.help: The tray at the bottom of the printer.

parts.label: Roller
parts.fact: The rollers grab the paper and pull it through the printer.
parts.help: The wheel inside the printer body.

parts.label: Ink Cartridge
parts.fact: The ink cartridges hold the colors that make the picture.
parts.help: The colored block in the middle.

parts.label: Output Tray
parts.fact: The output tray catches the printed page as it comes out.
parts.help: The shelf at the top of the printer.

parts.label: Casing
parts.fact: The casing is the outer shell that protects the printer parts.
parts.help: The main body of the printer.
